prompt:
Create a 10-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic vertical video (9:16).
A realistic gold biscuit lies abandoned on the muddy roadside after heavy rainfall. Rainwater flows around it as the object slowly sinks deep into the wet soil. Within seconds, the buried object begins to glow from underground. A tiny green sprout emerges from the exact spot and rapidly grows into a gigantic mature gold biscuit tree. The thick trunk and branches naturally resemble the shape, texture, colors, and design language of the original gold biscuit. Hundreds of fully detailed ripe gold biscuits hang from every branch like real fruits, gently swaying in the wind.
Immediately after the tree finishes growing, a large cargo truck arrives and stops beside it. One worker quickly climbs the tree while several others rapidly harvest every gold biscuit from the branches, tossing them into the truck with fast, realistic movements. Within moments the tree is completely harvested. The truck becomes fully loaded with hundreds of gold biscuits and drives away, leaving only the empty tree behind.
Single continuous shot, realistic rainy weather, muddy ground, cinematic lighting, natural wind, believable physics, ultra-detailed textures, smooth growth animation, seamless transformation, no cuts, no glitches, no flicker, no extra objects, 8K, HDR, hyper-realistic, documentary-style realism." note : gold buscuit start to end same ho agar ractengular hain to sb rectengular honey chahiye realistic

translations.zh:
创建一段10秒超逼真电影感竖屏视频（9:16）。
一块逼真的金饼在大雨过后遗弃在泥泞的路边。雨水流过周围，它缓慢沉入湿润土壤。几秒内，掩埋物在地下发光。一个细小的绿芽萌出并迅速长成一棵巨大的成熟金饼树。树干和树枝呈现原始金饼的质感与颜色。数百个逼真的金饼像果实一样挂在枝头并随风摆动。
树长成后，一辆货车驶来停在旁边。一名工人迅速爬树，其他人快速采摘并将金饼扔进车厢。片刻后全树采摘完毕。卡车载满金饼驶离，只留下一棵光秃秃的树。
单镜头一镜到底，雨天泥泞地面，电影光效，自然风动，平滑生长，8K HDR写实风格。
